note: Specs are taken from the documents listed for each system. 'confidence' says where a figure came from: datasheet (manufacturer document), installer (stated in an installer quote), assumed (a modelling assumption). Always confirm the exact model codes are on the Clean Energy Council approved list - that is required for the federal battery rebate. AC round-trip efficiency is assumed at 90% for all systems unless stated.

systems.name: KH10 + CQ7 (50 A)
systems.inverter: FoxESS KH10 single-phase hybrid, 10 kW (10.5 kVA max)
systems.module: CQ7-50 LFP module, 6.96 kWh usable (100% DoD)
systems.backup: EPS output 10 kVA (12 kW for 60 s), ~20 ms switchover; circuits wired to the backup board only
systems.pv: 4 MPPT, 16 A per input, max 15 kW PV input / 20 kWp array, 80-500 V MPPT, 600 V max

warranty.text: 70% capacity for 12 years or 5.08 MWh per usable kWh (212 MWh for L6), whichever first; must be registered at commissioning

notes: Battery power = 50 A x stack voltage (57.6 V per module): L2 5.8 kW, L3 8.6 kW, L4+ limited by the 10 kW inverter.
Max 7 modules on a KH is inferred from the KH's 480 V battery input limit - confirm with FoxESS.

sources.title: FoxESS Australia battery warranty policy v2.7

systems.name: ESA 10 kW + GW9.0 modules
systems.inverter: GoodWe ESA GW9.999K-EHA-G20 all-in-one, 9.999 kW single phase
systems.backup: Built-in backup port 10 kVA, <4 ms switchover
systems.pv: 4 MPPT, 20 A per input, up to 20 kW of panels, 40-560 V MPPT
notes: GoodWe's ESA page lists 35.6 A charge / 29 A discharge continuous battery current and 9,999 VA grid and backup output.
Charge up to 13.5 kW (DC, from solar), discharge 11 kW battery / 9.999 kW AC. Each module handles 4.5 kW.
Battery stack with the inverter is 1.6-1.9 m tall; check AS/NZS 5139 clearances.

systems.name: SigenStor EC 10.0 SP + BAT 10.0
systems.inverter: Sigenergy SigenStor EC 10.0 SP AU, 9.999 kW single phase
systems.module: SigenStor BAT 10.0 (9.04 kWh nominal), 8.76 kWh usable
systems.backup: Needs the Sigen Gateway (0 ms) - check it is included; without it there is no backup
systems.pv: 4 MPPT, 16 A per input, up to 20 kW of panels, 50-550 V MPPT

warranty.text: 10 years, >=70% or throughput limit (check Sigenergy's document)

notes: Installer quotes often show nominal capacity (5 x 9.04 = 45.2 kWh); usable is 8.76 kWh per module (5 = 43.8 kWh).
Each module is rated 4.6 kW continuous (6.9 kW for 10 s), so 1 module limits the battery to 4.6 kW.
ACCC recall (Nov 2025) of EC 10.0 SP AU units with quick-connect AC plugs: make sure the updated unit is supplied.
Battery warranty reportedly starts once the system is connected to the Sigen cloud.

systems.name: SH10RS + SBH
systems.module: SBH battery module, 5.0 kWh usable (SBH100 = 2 modules ... SBH400 = 8)
systems.backup: Built-in 63 A bypass for whole-house backup, <10 ms
systems.pv: 4 MPPT, 16 A per input, up to 20 kW of panels, 40-560 V MPPT, 600 V max
notes: SBH100-400: 5 kWh usable per module, 50 A continuous, 100% DoD (settable).

Check compatibility: the SBH400 operates at ~475-642 V, while the SH10RS AU datasheet (V2, 2023) lists a 80-460 V battery input. Ask the installer for Sungrow's compatibility confirmation for the exact inverter version.

systems.name: Powerwall 3 + Expansion
systems.module: Powerwall 3 or Expansion unit, 13.5 kWh usable
